A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same deep-SSM generalization-bound work. All 25 pages of v1 and 22 pages of v2, including appendices, are readable, and the equations, tables, and relocated arguments support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports theoretical bounds and proofs, without original experiments or data analyses. Table 1 summarizes architectures from cited work.

after.justification: v2 remains theoretical throughout the main text and appendices. Its architecture and contraction-constant tables do not report empirical outcomes.

M1.justification: The analyzed SSM recurrence, MLP/GLU computations, residual blocks, and encoder/decoder architecture remain. No learning or inference procedure is introduced or revised; changes concern the theoretical framework and its stated scope.

E1.justification: Neither version actually trains or evaluates on datasets or test scenarios. v1's Long Range Arena mention describes prior work.

E2.justification: Neither version evaluates comparison methods. Both retain S4, S4D, S5, and LRU in the descriptive architecture table.

E3.justification: Neither version specifies an implemented experimental evaluation protocol. Revisions to theoretical input spaces and assumptions are not experimental-setting changes.

E4.justification: Neither version contains ablations, robustness experiments, error analyses, or empirical case studies. The appendices develop mathematical arguments.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, empirical uncertainty estimates, or significance tests. PAC confidence parameters belong to the theoretical analysis.

E6.justification: Neither version reports experimental scores, rankings, or observed qualitative findings. Changes to analytic bound expressions are assessed under T1.

T1.justification: v2 Lemma 12 replaces v1 Lemma 21's timewise affine-matrix formulation with general bounded linear operators and a revised proof. Appendix A adds a finite/infinite-horizon norm argument, while Remark 19 and Theorem 20 replace explicit intermediate-radius conditions with a recursive radius construction. Lemma 14 also changes deep-MLP additive constants to power sums and revises the GLU bound. Its sigmoid statement omits the explicit symmetry condition present in v1, although the proof still invokes it.

C1.justification: The central length-independent PAC-bound claim remains, but the promised scope changes substantially. v2 drops v1's blanket assertion that all definitions, theorems, and proofs cover continuous/discrete time and classification/regression. It newly claims the first generalization bound for deep SSMs and replaces the introduction's implicit-depth-dependence description with explicit discussion of depth growth controlled through system norms.

C2.justification: v2 adds explanations of controlling depth growth through small system norms, representing complex SSMs with real matrices, and stability after discretization. It removes v1's normalization-folding rationale and discussion of input-dependent discretization. The central interpretation linking stability and generalization is retained.

D1.justification: Neither version supplies an implementation, experimental hyperparameters, hardware information, or code/data access instructions. System-norm computation guidance is retained from v1 Remark 4 in v2 Remark 7.

R1.justification: v2 substantially contracts the research positioning. It removes v1's comparisons and citations concerning autoregressive models, stochastic differential equations, online PAC-Bayes learning, and spectral/Fisher-Rao depth bounds. Detailed comparisons with earlier contraction approaches are also compressed, while the introduction adds a broader first-bound novelty claim.

P1.justification: The introduction and related work are extensively condensed, and the main narrative is reorganized around preliminaries, contraction, and an informal theorem. Material formerly developed in the main text and two appendices is redistributed across Appendices A–E. The title, affiliations, headers, and numerous explanations are also edited.

P2.justification: Table 1 moves into Appendix B and its entries are shortened. The contraction table is expanded to consolidate MLP and GLU bounds previously presented separately. Headers, citation coloring, and equation placement change, while the basic single-column layout remains.

improvement.justification: The shorter exposition and general-operator lemma improve accessibility, but the mathematical rewrites have unresolved costs. Remark 19 multiplies functions defined as output radii instead of composing those radius maps, making its recursive justification problematic. Lemma 14 also omits v1's sigmoid-symmetry condition while its proof still uses it. These issues prevent a reliable net-quality judgment despite the presentation gains.
